plumbing.review:
Two correctness gaps need fixes:

- **[P2] Run selection depends on the dashboard’s timezone** — [live.go:778](live.go:778). Directory names use the watcher’s local time, but status timestamps are UTC. With a UTC watcher and an Eastern dashboard, an old `100000` directory becomes 14:00 UTC and passes a retry’s 10:01 UTC cutoff, exposing previous-run commands. Reversing those timezones hides valid runs. Establish the run association independently of the dashboard’s timezone.

- **[P2] A same-second retry can reuse the previous transcript** — [live.go:779](live.go:779). Truncating `Since` allows an old directory from `10:00:00` to satisfy a retry starting at `10:00:00.750`, before its transcript is replaced. Both fresh and warmed readers can return old commands under the new step. The acceptance fixture separates runs by a minute ([act_shell_accept_test.go:446](act_shell_accept_test.go:446)), so it misses this case.

The patch otherwise stays within the allowed files and follows surrounding naming, comments and idioms. Acceptance sources match the plan, and the factory reports passing checks; I did not rerun write-producing tests. I found no test special-casing, weakened Access checks, added external access, or public command disclosure. Command rendering uses inert text. Browser lifecycle behavior is reviewed statically; the page acceptance test checks only initial HTML.

The merger must also record the private-retention decision and add its citation at [SPEC.md:135](SPEC.md:135), as the plan explicitly requires.

VERDICT: changes needed — fix current-run isolation for differing timezones and same-second retries, add regression coverage, and have the merger record and cite the required decision.
